profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.jobTitle: AI/ML - Staff Software Engineer / Engineering lead
profile.summary: I'm a Staff Software Engineer and Engineering Lead at Apple with over a decade of experience building innovative AI/ML solutions. My journey spans from military logistics leadership to mobile browser optimization, culminating in leading critical AI infrastructure for Siri and Apple's on-device ML systems.

positions.title: AI/ML - Staff Software Engineer / Engineering lead
positions.description: Staff Software Engineer and Engineering Lead driving AI/ML infrastructure initiatives across Apple's ecosystem. Led critical teams responsible for Siri, AI/ML B&I, and on-device ML model validation systems.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior engineer focused on quality assurance and test automation for Skyfire's Rocket Optimizer platform, a revolutionary server-side solution that dynamically optimized mobile video content in real-time to enhance user experience and reduce cellular bandwidth consumption.

- Architected and implemented comprehensive end-to-end testing framework for Rocket Optimizer's real-time video processing pipeline
- Collaborated with engineering teams to establish quality gates and performance benchmarks for mobile video optimization technology

positions.title: Sr. Software QA Engineer
positions.description:
Senior QA engineer and project lead managing Opera's strategic carrier partnerships and mobile application ecosystem across Asia-Pacific markets. Spearheaded Opera Web Pass initiatives and mobile browser development for major telecommunications providers.

- Successfully launched Opera Web Pass across 4 major carriers (DiGi, DTAC, Maxis, MTSUA), enabling millions of users to access optimized mobile browsing
- Led development and deployment of Opera Mini Widget for Verizon Wireless, expanding Opera's presence in the US mobile market
- Pioneered HTML5 application development for Opera TV Store, establishing early connected TV app ecosystem and user experience standards
- Managed comprehensive cross-platform testing strategies covering mobile, carrier billing integration, and multi-device compatibility validation

positions.title: Software QA Engineer / System Administrator
positions.description:
Dual-role technical leader managing mobile browser product delivery for Korea's largest telecommunications companies while maintaining critical server infrastructure. Pioneered Opera's mobile browser penetration in the Korean market during the smartphone revolution era.

- Successfully delivered Opera Mini/Mobile integrations for Korea's top 4 mobile manufacturers and carriers: SK Telecom, Samsung, LG Electronics, and Pantech
- Engineered sophisticated test automation frameworks integrating Opera Mini cloud services with SK Telecom's billing infrastructure, ensuring seamless carrier-grade deployment
- Led comprehensive multi-platform validation across 6 mobile operating systems (Android, iOS, Windows Mobile, BrewMP, J2ME, BlackBerry), ensuring consistent user experience
- Architected and maintained high-availability production server environments supporting millions of daily mobile browser sessions with 99.9% uptime

positions.title: Storage Section NCOIC and Warehouse IMO, Sergeant
positions.description:
Non-Commissioned Officer in Charge leading critical medical logistics operations for US 8th Army in Korea. Served as bilingual liaison and technical systems manager in the prestigious Korean Augmentation Troops program, bridging US-Korean military cooperation during active deployment.

- Led storage section operations managing $2M+ in critical medical supplies and equipment for 18th Medical Command's 16th Medical Logistics Battalion
- Served as Warehouse Information Management Officer (IMO), implementing digital inventory systems and optimizing supply chain efficiency for multinational operations
- Specialized in Maintenance, Repair, Operations (MRO) denial protocols, ensuring mission-critical medical equipment readiness across forward operating bases
- Demonstrated exceptional cross-cultural leadership as Korean-American bridge between US command structure and Korean augmentation forces, facilitating seamless bilateral military cooperation
